title: Implement account settings page with profile, plan, and billing
acceptance_criteria: Settings page at /dashboard/settings with tabs: Profile, Plan, Billing
Profile tab: edit name, email, password change form
Plan tab: show current plan, upgrade/downgrade options, feature comparison table
Billing tab: payment method (Stripe), invoice history, cancel subscription
All forms validated client-side before submission
Changes saved with success toast on confirmation
Delete account button with confirmation flow and data deletion notice
